design_fields.q1_rationale: The study is a systematic review and does not analyze student-level PIRLS microdata, thus plausible values are not applicable.
design_fields.q2_rationale: As a systematic review, the study does not involve student-level sampling frames or the application of sampling weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, as it is a systematic review.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any validation strategies, as it is a systematic review of existing literature rather than an empirical analysis.
